plain_english_revision: This amendment adds a new section to the bill that explicitly prohibits state-funded child placing agencies from discriminating against individuals based on race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or age.
candidate_position_supported: The amendment advances a policy of non-discrimination by mandating that any child placing agency receiving state funding cannot exclude individuals based on protected characteristics such as race, religion, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
evidence_quotes: "no child placing agency... shall discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or age."
